review_candidates.title: UN Women: Technical Specialist: Integrated Programming and Coordination, Home-Based, International Consultant
review_candidates.description: Background JOB DESCRIPTION UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. UN Women has been in Afghanistan for two decades. UN Women’s programming approach is informed by analysis of the political, economic and humanitarian situation, risks to and capacities of partner organizations, and needs of Afghan women and girls. UN Women Afghanistan currently has five key programme priorities: (1) Integrated Programming and Localization, (2) Women’s movement building through core grant making; 3) Policy and Research; 4) Economic Resilience and Private Sector and 5) Coordination, Access and Humanitarian Response. UN Women Afghanistan operates through its main office in Kabul and five sub-offices located in the provinces of Balkh, Bamyan, Herat, Kandahar and Nangarhar. UN Women Afghanistan Country Office operates in a highly constrained and rapidly evolving context. The Country Office’s programming is shaped by political, economic, humanitarian, and protection-related developments, as well as by the capacities and risks facing women’s organizations and implementing partners. Within this setting, the Integrated services portfolio plays a critical role in supporting women and girls through EVAW programming, essential protection services and humanitarian programming, coordination with civil society organizations, and quality oversight of implementing partners. Following recent organizational restructuring and funding reductions, the Integrated Services team requires short-term coordination support for six months. The assignment will prioritize closure of partner agreements, onboarding and implementation readiness of new partners, coordination of key thematic initiatives including the 16 Days of Activism, technical follow-up on gender-based violence (GBV) and psychosocial support (PSS), and programme quality assessments. The support will help maintain business continuity and ensure timely, compliant, and results-focused delivery. The objective of the consultancy is to provide time-bound programme coordination and technical support to the Integrated Programming and Localization Unit, with particular attention to partner closure and onboarding, thematic coordination, programme quality assurance, and completion of priority programme management actions. Description Of Responsibilities /Scope Of Work Under the direct supervision of the Integrated Programming and Localization Programme Manager, and in close coordination with relevant programme, operations, Sub-Office, and partner personnel, the Programme Coordinator will: 1- Provide Advisory Support and Technical Programme Guidance for the Integrated Programme Unit Lead and coordinate effective project management and programme implementation, including technical advice to Sub-Offices for appropriate and efficient partner management to ensure smooth workflow and processes for results-based management; Manage the monitoring of project implementation, including coordination with Sub-Offices on all integrated programming initiatives to ensure adherence to implementation rates and utilization of resources to meet agreed upon targets and results; Lead the design of the Localization Workflow Analyze and ensure alignment of project documents and budgets with the Integrated Programme Unit’s workplan and overall objectives; Provide technical advice on project planning, implementation and management and ensure quality assurance at Sub-Office levels. Supports the development of the Integrated Programming Strategy Facilitate effective information flow, communication and coordination across the unit and between Sub-Offices and other ACO units and pillars; and 2- Manage capacity development to project/programme partners Provide technical support and advisory services to responsible parties and civil society partners on programme implementation, compliance, and quality standards. Design and deliver targeted coaching, mentoring, and capacity-building support to partners in areas such as results-based management, reporting, service quality, safeguarding, and survivor-centered programming. Support the design and rollout of calls for proposals, partner selection processes, partner onboarding, and implementation readiness. Conduct performance assessment of the current Programme partners to inform partner prioritization and selection for 2027 Advise on engagement with women-led organizations, women activists, shelters, and relevant coordination platforms, including the Afghan Shelter Network where relevant. 3- Coordinate partner agreement closure and onboarding Lead the review of partner agreements due for closure and establish priorities, timelines and accountabilities for completing all 2026 outstanding actions. Oversee the completion of narrative, financial, programmatic, compliance, asset, refund and documentation requirements for partner agreement closure. Analyze closure bottlenecks and risks and recommend timely corrective or escalation measures. Coordinate closure actions across programme, finance, operations, Sub-Offices and responsible partners and ensure that decisions and follow-up actions are properly documented. Manage the programmatic onboarding of newly selected responsible partners and amendments, including orientation, risk review, workplan finalization, compliance readiness and implementation planning for Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. 4- Coordinate thematic programme priorities Lead the planning and coordination of the 16 Days of Activism across programme teams, Sub-Offices and responsible partners, ensuring coherence, timely implementation and consolidated reporting. Facilitate collaboration among UN Women teams, responsible partners and relevant stakeholders to strengthen coherence across thematic interventions. Provide technical oversight and coordination for GBV and PSS interventions, including essential services, referral pathways, safeguarding and survivor-centred approaches. Identify thematic implementation gaps, emerging risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate programmatic responses. Represent the Integrated Programming and Localization Unit in relevant technical discussions and coordination mechanisms, including GBV, protection and mental health and psychosocial support forums, as delegated by the Programme Manager. 5- Manage knowledge building efforts Manage the process of identifying and synthesizing of best practices and lessons learned that are directly linked to the implementation of the Programme and contribute to their global dissemination. Finalize lessons learned and communication products on ACO work in prisons, Drug Treatment and Male engagement efforts 6- Strengthen monitoring, reporting, and programme coordination Monitor priority actions, results, risks, and delivery timelines and recommend timely corrective action where required. Review and Finalise the EU Report and supporting documents Prepare and consolidate briefing notes, progress summaries, management updates, presentations, donor inputs, and other programme documentation. Coordinate regular follow-up with programme teams, Sub-Offices, operations colleagues, and partners to resolve implementation issues and maintain a clear record of decisions and actions. Document lessons learned, good practices, recurring gaps, and recommendations to support programme improvement and handover. 7- Build partnerships and provide support in developing resource mobilization strategies Develop and implement partnerships and resource mobilization strategies; Lead coordination with Sub-Offices to support the development of a standard Integrated Programme Proposal to be adapted per various funding opportunities Analyze and research information on donors, finalize substantive briefs on possible areas of cooperation, identification of opportunities for resource mobilization and cost sharing; Determine programmatic areas of cooperation, based on strategic goals of UN Women, country needs and donors’ priorities and develop the relevant partnerships. Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel This consultancy is primarily home-based. The consultant is expected to work closely with the Afghanistan Country Office team and maintain availability during Afghanistan working hours as required for coordination. Travel to Kabul may be required for strategic planning, coordination, training, or programme review purposes, subject to security conditions, organizational approval, and availability of funds. Competencies Core Values: Integrity; Professionalism; Respect for Diversity. Core Competencies Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues; Accountability; Creative Problem Solving; Effective Communication; Inclusive Collaboration; Stakeholder Engagement; Leading by Example. Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework: Functional Competencies Strong programme formulation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation skills. Ability to develop detailed operational plans, budgets, and deliver on them. Ability to synthesize program performance data and produce analytical reports to inform management and strategic decision-making. Strong analytical skills. Strong knowledge of Results Based Management. Good knowledge of UN programme management systems. IV. Required Qualifications Education and Certification: Master’s degree or equivalent in Social Sciences, Political Science, Public Health, Development, Public Administration, Gender is required. A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree. A project/programme management certification (such as PMP®, PRINCE2®, or MSP®) would be an added advantage. Experience At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in project and programme development, strategic planning, coordination support or change management is required. Proven track record of drafting and advising on high-quality proposals, reports, strategic notes and related documents for senior officials is required. International development experience preferably focused on or strongly involved in project management and gender equality at national, regional and/or international levels is required. Technical knowledge of gender equality programming in EVAW, GIHA, Public Health and livelihoods is required Experience in an international organization is required. Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages, and experience in handling of web-based management systems is required. Experience in the use of a modern web-based ERP System, preferably Oracle Cloud, is desirable. Technical expertise in all aspects of project management including planning, financial management, budget management, risk management, communications and stakeholder engagement is desirable. Experience in dealing with bilateral and multilateral funding sources is desirable. Prior experience in the UN System is desirable. Languages Fluency in English is required. Working knowledge of another official UN language is desirable; knowledge of Dari or Pashto desirable Statements In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment. Diversity And Inclusion At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need. If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application. UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. review_candidates.description: 募集職種： チャンネル・メディアオペレーションズ エグゼクティブ | Channel and Media Operations Executive 本ポジションでは、テレビ放送および各種動画配信プラットフォームにおけるメディアオペレーション業務全般を担当していただきます。オペレーションディレクターのもと、社内外の関係者と連携し、各チャンネルおよび配信プラットフォームにおいて、コンテンツが予定どおり放送・配信できるよう、必要な準備や進行管理、関係者との調整を行っていただきます。また、各チャンネルの放送運用ガイドラインに沿った番組送出を確保することが求められます。 変化の速い環境にも柔軟に対応し、複数の業務を並行して進められる方を求めています。業務の優先順位を適切に判断し、主体性と協調性を持って自律的に業務を遂行できることが期待されます。 主な業務内容： 社内外のメディアアセット管理システムに関連するコンテンツのメタデータおよび記録を維持・管理し、A+E Global Mediaの各ブランド・各プラットフォーム向けファイル納品システムを運用・管理する。 ノンリニア配信に関する社内の最新スケジュールおよびレポーティングシステムを把握する。 社内関係部署や外部ベンダーと連携し、VOD向けメタデータおよびコンテンツ素材が適切に納品されるよう調整する。 ポストプロダクション業務の進行を支援し、優先度に応じて映像編集を自ら行う、または必要に応じて編集作業を管理・監督する。 上長と連携し、リニア放送、OTT、VOD、デジタルその他の社内外プラットフォームにおける放送・配信上の技術的問題や素材納品に関する問題の解決に対応する。 番組が放送基準・各種要件に適合し、放送可能な状態となるようコンプライアンス対応を調整する。必要な字幕・吹替等の言語対応作業に進められる状態を整える。 各市場のビジネス要件に沿った字幕・吹替の制作・手配・進行を管理し、必要な言語版が用意されるよう調整する。 チャンネル運用サービス提供会社が作成する送出ログについて、各チャンネルの運用上の優先事項および放送運用ガイドラインへの適合を確認し、適切な放送運用と視聴品質の維持を図る。 報告された送出関連の問題に対応し、技術面での品質および放送上の品質水準を高く維持する。 外部関係者との連携を含むメディアオペレーション業務全般を管理・調整し、各チャンネルおよび指定プラットフォームにおいて、コンテンツが期限内に放送・配信可能な状態となるよう進行管理を行う。 社内システムを主体的に維持・管理し、業務フロー全体の効率化を推進する。 必要となるスキル・経験： 番組送出オペレーションまたはメディアオペレーションにおける3～5年程度の実務経験 日本語・英語の双方における優れた口頭・文書コミュニケーション能力 映像・音声ファイル形式、放送送出系統、ファイル納品システム・プロセスに関する知識と理解 社内外の関係者との円滑なコミュニケーション能力および対人対応力・顧客対応スキル 細部まで注意を払い、体系的かつ正確に業務を遂行できる能力 複数の業務を並行して管理し、優先順位を適切に判断できる能力 プレッシャーのかかる状況や厳しい納期にも柔軟に対応できる能力 主体性、行動力、熱意を持って業務に取り組む姿勢 Description of Position: Reporting to the Director Operations, you will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the media operations, including those with external parties, ensuring timely readiness of the content for broadcast on the channels and other identified platforms. With guidance from your manager, you will also ensure output of the channel conforms to the on-air guidelines defined for that channel. You are someone who has a high degree of flexibility, can operate effectively in a very fast moving environment and has a strong ability to multi-task under minimal supervision. You must be able to prioritize multiple assignments and have an understanding of how to best assimilate in a new group. You take initiative, works extremely well with other people, can work autonomously, and are interested in growth. Responsibilities: Upkeep the metadata and related records of such media as it relates to internal or external Media Asset Management System and maintain file delivery systems for all platforms across all brands owned by A+E Global Media Responsible for having knowledge of the company’s current schedules and reporting systems as they pertain to the non-linear schedule Work with internal departments and Vendors to ensure VOD metadata and asset delivery Facilitate post production tasks, as well as directly editing projects as the priority level dictates (Edit video content and / or oversee as and when required) Work with Manager to Trouble shoot on-air technical issues and other technical issues that relate to the delivery of materials for all content related operations: Linear broadcast, OTT, VOD, Digital and other content related platforms (in-house or external). Coordinate program compliance activities across the assigned channels to ensure that all broadcasted programming is made compliant, suitable for broadcast and ready for languaging activities where required Manage and coordinate the language subtitling and dubbing requirements for the assigned on-air channels, ensuring that the assigned channels for A+E Global Media contain the required language subtitles and dubs targeted for the various markets of such channels, as per the business requirements Ensure transmission logs produced by the Channel Services provider comply with the priorities and on-air guidelines defined for that channel, delivering the intended experience to the viewers Maintain quality of the channels and ensure its technical presentation is kept to high standards by following up on transmission matters reported on the assigned channels Manage and take responsibility of all aspects of the media operations, including those with external parties, ensuring timely readiness of the content for broadcast on the channels and other identified platforms Take initiative to maintain/control internal systems to enhance efficiencies for overall workflows Requirements 3-5 years’ experience in playout operations and/or media operations Excellent written & oral communication (in both English and Japanese), as well as interpersonal and customer service skills. Good understanding of file formats, transmission chain, file delivery solutions Good communication skills and a team player Meticulous and systematic Thrive under pressure and tight deadlines, possess initiative, drive, and passion
